games.title: Bearing Lock
games.description: Lock into true nautical and aerial bearings across global landmarks, cities, and corridors on an interactive 360° tactile compass dial.

games.title: LogicGate: Silicon Circuit Academy
games.description: Tactile, low-key educational puzzle game teaching logic gates (AND, OR, NOT, XOR, NAND, NOR) to normies. Solve real-world circuits from vaults to rockets.

games.title: OrbitDrop
games.description: 2D Keplerian orbital mechanics. Slingshot micro-probes around multi-body gravity wells into portal beacons.

games.title: ScaleCraft
games.description: Physical scale comparison higher/lower blitz across 80+ entities from microscopic viruses to cosmic planets.

games.title: Flag Hex Reflex
games.description: Rapid-fire 3-second visual country identification from minimalist abstract color swatches.

games.title: CityGrid
games.description: Identify world cities from minimalist glowing vector street grid patterns and urban layout geometries.

games.title: Chronos
games.description: Guess the exact year of historical, scientific, and pop-culture milestones with a precision thumb slider. Rapid-fire 5-round blitz.

games.title: Roots
games.description: Rapid-fire 60-second linguistic etymology trivia across 160+ surnames and 8 language families.

games.title: Ethnos
games.description: Anthropological composite and regional demographic guessing inspired by humanphenotypes.org.

games.title: Cyber-Shinobi
games.description: Strategic card crawler with equipment absorbing math, ninjutsu meter, and sector bosses.

feedbackHistory.notes: Excellent tactile feedback and card movement mechanics.

ideaBacklog.title: Chronos: Year Slider
ideaBacklog.hook: A world-historical event is named. Guess the exact year using an exponential thumb slider. Closer = more points.

ideaBacklog.title: Flag Hex Reflex
ideaBacklog.hook: Identify the country flag from 3 rapid-fire primary RGB color swatches appearing in sequence.
